fix(csv-parse): only destroy on end when the stream has destroy (fix #409) (#538)

The browser builds bundle a stream polyfill whose Transform has no
`destroy` method. When the parser stops because of the `to` or `to_line`
options, or ends on an empty input, it registers `this.destroy` as an
`end` listener, which throws "listener argument must be a function".

Register the listener only when `destroy` is a function. Node.js streams
always have it, so their behavior is unchanged.
